name: NusukChat 2.8.8: AI Chat Messages Default and Error use DL CTAs
source: The DL Advisor's update to 💬 Chat UI › AI Chat Messages, Style=Default (80392:4581) and Style=Error (80392:4595), 23 November 2026.

changed.change: Follow-up actions are DL CTA Kind=Primary, Size=SM, State=Default, Icon=Right with arrow-right-02 (mirrored in RTL), replacing Chip White LR. Tags row: wrap, 8 between and 8 between rows, from the start edge, 12 below. Content No BG with 18 inline padding, help-circle on, footer timestamp only.
DL Alerts Type=Error (alert-02) at full width, 18 above the actions; actions are CTA Primary XS, Icon=Right, arrow-right-02, same wrap, 12 below.

openDL: DL Chip proposal for chat answers is withdrawn: Chips is now proposed as a use of DL Button, not a Chip variant.

native.ios: Follow-ups: a wrapping flow (spacing 8, line spacing 8) of the DL primary button at .small (38) or .xSmall (26 for Error) with a trailing arrow.right that flips with layoutDirection; 12 bottom padding.
native.android: Follow-ups: FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = spacedBy(8.dp), verticalArrangement = spacedBy(8.dp)) of DL PrimaryButton(size = Sm or Xs, trailingIcon = arrow_right_02, autoMirrored = true); padding(bottom = 12.dp).

breaking: Chips and ErrorMsg render DL Buttons by default; pass chip: true for the old chip. The buttons prop is removed (it is now the default).
Chip clicks no longer set aria-pressed; selection state is the flow's job.
